description: This source file defines a serializer class GuidCodec for serializing and deserializing System.Guid objects within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for writing, reading, and handling raw byte data of GUIDs, optimized for different runtime environments.

classes.name: GuidCodec
classes.description: A serializer class for Guid objects, implementing the IFieldCodec<Guid> interface, providing methods for serializing and deserializing GUIDs with optimized raw byte handling.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Guid value into the provided buffer writer with length prefix.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a Guid value from the reader, verifying length and returning the deserialized Guid.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes the raw byte representation of a Guid to the buffer, handling endianness and runtime differences.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads raw Guid bytes from the reader and constructs a Guid object, optimized for different frameworks.
